audit.why: Difficulty 7.5/10 with a 54.88% Shen win rate over 860 games is consistent: Rumble owns levels 1-6 with Flamespitter burn, Shen takes over once tanky and once Stand United makes the lane secondary.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Level 6 was 'Skill' and both First item and 2+ items went to Rumble, which contradicts the packet chart (Rumble / Skill / Shen), the 54.88% win rate, and this page's own whys[4], whys[6], spikes[3] and 'late' text that all describe Shen taking over at two items.
audit.why: Rumble's real 1v1 peak is level 6 with his first AP item; Shen's tank core plus Stand United is the scaling side. The page rendered Shen losing the exact stage its own prose says he wins.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] -> Rumble, phases[5]/win[5] -> Skill, phases[6]/win[6] -> Shen, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] claimed Rumble's overheat autos 'bypass' Spirit's Refuge's auto-block 'with his stronger hits'. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks that would hit Shen or allies near the spirit blade regardless of how much damage they carry — a bigger auto is still an auto. The page also built the whole matchup around tracking Scrap Shield, a flat 6-second cooldown, instead of Flamespitter.
audit.why: Riot's W text is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — no damage threshold. What Spirit's Refuge genuinely cannot stop is Flamespitter's cone burn and Electro Harpoon, because those are spells, not attacks. And a 6s shield is not a punish window; Flamespitter at 10/9/8/7/6 is the cooldown that decides trades.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1], dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t rewritten to state the real split: W blanks autos and overheat autos, never the burn; Flamespitter's cooldown is the punish window.
sources: brief enemyKit P/Q/E text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Scrap Shield (6s flat) as the matchup-defining cooldown.
audit.why: A 6-second shield can never be played around; Flamespitter is 10s at rank 1 and is what gates his trade.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns around Flamespitter 10s->6s and Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] title 'Stack pure HP vs %damage' carried a description about burning a cooldown for tiny value — unrelated to its own heading.
audit.why: Rumble's damage is magic and AP-scaling, so the correct don't is raw HP over MR.
audit.corrected: Description now states Flamespitter scales on AP and max health, so MR beats raw HP.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
